text:
Maya Chen: 5 minutes until we go live. Quick heads-up: a few remote attendees pinged about choppy audio in Zoom. If Zoom drops we'll switch to the YouTube embed and post the link.
Lin (SRE): Seeing brief encoder CPU spikes on av-encoder-01 during the rehearsal. I'll restart the encoder process now, shouldn't affect live if it holds.
Devon - AV: Camera 1 lost autofocus mid-rehearsal; locked to manual and bumped exposure. If Cam1 freezes, we'll cut to B-cam on the switcher (hotkey F3).
Maya Chen: Noted. Can someone confirm recorder health and upload path?
recorder-bot: Local recording running. Final upload target: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2834567890/final.mp4. I'll retry upload on token errors.
Priya Gomez: I've queued two Leadership Qs: 1) Dedicated SLAs roadmap + expected GA timeline, 2) How we'll surface SLA options in Console. Adding both to the live Q doc.
Chris - CEO: I'll handle the GA timeline high-level; Product can answer Console UX specifics in the AMA. Keep them brief.
Sam - Sales: Heads-up: a partner on the call wants a short demo of Dedicated latency numbers after the talk. Can we schedule a follow-up slot?
Maya Chen: Let's schedule a 20-min partner session next Wed. I'll DM logistics.
Lin (SRE): If encoder process becomes unresponsive:
```
sudo systemctl restart av-encoder
# check: journalctl -u av-encoder -n 200 --no-pager
```
Devon - AV: If switcher loses connection, fallback is: flip manual HDMI on output 2 and start local capture on recorder-B. Backup recorder command:
```
ssh recorder-b
/usr/local/bin/start_capture --slot allhands-2834567890
```
Anya - Legal: Quick privacy note for the recording: ensure the slide with customer logos (slide 14) has consented logos only. Priya, can you confirm?
Priya Gomez: Confirmed, slide 14 pruned to approved logos only (v5). Link to deck v5 in Drive.
deploy-bot: No autopromotes scheduled during the next 45m. Will pause on CPU > 80% on inference-prod.
recorder-bot: Upload attempt 1 failed: 403 TokenExpired. Retrying with refreshed token.
Lin (SRE): I've extended the IAM token TTL for the upload service. recorder-bot should succeed now.
Maya Chen: Order tweak: leadership -> infra -> product highlights -> customer Q&A. If infra overlaps, we'll shorten product to highlights.
Chris - CEO: Good plan. I'll aim for <7 minutes and then hand to Product for the roadmap bullets.
Sam - Sales: Also flagging a partner privacy question; Anya might want to join the follow-up.
Anya - Legal: Happy to join. Please share partner name in DM.
Maya Chen: Final: presenters use wired ethernet, mute when not speaking. If Zoom audio degrades, we'll post the YT link and continue. I'll post final slide link and speaking order in 2m. :thumbsup:
